narrationAndDownloadConditions.evidence: Narration selection and silent-state labels are separate from slide language; inspect current behavior before adding any promise.

Regional pack selector differentiates slides-only from slides plus available English narration/clips and has English fallback notices; download promises must remain limited to files actually available.
